target_customer: Self-funded employers and payment integrity teams at payers that pay medical claims
problem: Medical bills and records contain coding errors, upcoding and unsupported diagnoses, and patients or plan sponsors lack the time and expertise to audit them.
business_model: Success fee as a small percentage of savings, later AI software for payment integrity teams
product_category: Healthcare AI, medical bill and record auditing

founders.name: Pranov Duggasani
founders.background_notes: Former AI engineer per the YC page.

founders.name: Zoe Holderness
founders.background_notes: Idea began after she disputed a $1,400 gynecologist bill (YC page; a 2023 Self-Funded podcast interview describes the same origin).

competitors.name: Alaffia Health
competitors.what: AI to detect errors in hospital bills for payers

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading itemized bills and clinical records against coding rules needed domain data and NLP, feasible for a small team with ex-Google and Microsoft AI engineers, but with access to records the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: No stated proprietary data or integration lock-in in sources; several auditing startups addressed the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC page lists the company as acquired, but no acquirer or date is public in the sources found.

market_need_then: Founder experience of an erroneous bill plus a widely cited belief that many US claims contain errors; the Alaffia coverage in 2022 cites an estimate that about 80 percent of claims have at least one error.

branding.domain_note: Used slingshotml.com rather than an exact slingshot.com (YC listing); date unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the name is shared with Slingshot AI, Slingshot Aerospace and Slingshot Insurance, which dominate search results.

pivots.from: Consumer and employer medical bill auditing and negotiation
pivots.to: AI analysis of medical records for payment integrity teams
pivots.why: Directories show the later positioning as record analysis for payers; the reason is not stated.

outcome_analysis: Slingshot joined YC in Summer 2022 with a four person team and a consumer and employer medical bill audit product, later describing itself as AI that checks whether diagnoses are supported by clinical evidence. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date, price or funding round beyond YC and Pioneer Fund as investors was found, so the outcome cannot be explained further.
notes: Company site slingshotml.com did not resolve from the session network, so the site check is a dead or blocked note. Searches returned a different company, Slingshot AI (mental health, $30M seed 2024), which is unrelated and was excluded. Acquisition rests on the YC status only. The Alaffia source is dated October 2022, after the S22 batch start, so it is only loosely contemporaneous.
